description: Find cloud GPUs to rent now: price per GPU hour and the stock each provider reported at the last daily check. Rentable offers come first, cheapest first. Give the buyer rent_url; it opens the provider (some are referral links, same price for the buyer).

gpu.description: GPU model, e.g. "H100", "B300", "RTX 4090". Omit for every model.

in_stock.description: Only offers the provider reports in stock. Default true.

limit.description: How many offers, default 20, at most 100.

min_gpus.description: Smallest node size needed, e.g. 8 for an 8x node.

name: find_gpu
